_readme: How Office_Level2 starts (Level2OfficeStart). Office_Level2 is a one-time copy of Office_Level1, so it still contains Level 1's plaza clients, Arthur and the corkboard side quest.
spawn / face: scene paths. The player stands part way from spawn to face (blend 0..1), looking at face. Same placement as the Tutorial Hub office drills.
hide: scene objects switched off before anything starts (deactivated, never deleted). Level 1's own scene is not touched.
disableComponents: component class names switched off in this scene before they start (e.g. the old Level 1 popup tutorial).
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.
